$comment: Glossary for L-13 (doc 06 §3.7, §4.3; doc 08 §7.2; R64). Sources: doc 08 §7.2.1 tables T-A–T-E (fr column = the app's xcstrings names), §7.2.2 rules ①–③ and fix X7 (the app's tip says 'Double-cliquez', mouse wording; the site writes 'touchez deux fois'), §7.3 fr row (vous; 'balayez … vers la droite', 'touchez deux fois'), §7.5 jargon row (C-16).

required: kickers and quota-table rows use the app's names (rule ①). Kickers drop the '(Signification IA)' suffix like en / ja; the lookup row keeps the full name. Action Flow keeps the App Store name (doc 08 D3, §7.2.3); the app's 'Fil d’actions' is quoted in features[chunks].text. The app writes AI in 'Lecture AI' / 'Prononciation AI' and IA elsewhere: names are quoted as the app shows them, sentences say IA.

contains: app button and setting names the sentences quote verbatim between « » (rule ①; T-E for faq.items[restore]). The website sets the app's straight apostrophe as the typographic ’ (French typography, same characters otherwise).

banned: 'balayage' as a noun reads as 'scanning' (doc 08 §7.5 jargon, C-16; also claims-lint jargon) — the gesture is the verb 'balayer'; mouse wording (X7); left swipes (F14); a single tap for lookup (doc 08 §1.1); the English noun 'double-tap' in sentences (doc 08 §7.3). The app's own feature name 'Double-tapez pour rechercher' stays in the kicker and the quota table (it does not match \bdouble-tap\b).
